name: Heidi
text: We count it amongst our greatest blessings that we met Jacob! When we first connected back in May 2025, we were complete newbies in home-buying and weren't even sure if we could make it happen. Jacob's willingness to be our guide even then really moved us. And now, over a year later, he helped us make it to the other side safely, joyfully, miraculously in front of our perfect home. The whole process could have easily overwhelmed us, but he clearly and kindly lit the way. We were so grateful for his experience, the connections he shared, his insights, honesty, patience, communicativeness, integrity, the list goes on. We could not have had a better realtor on our side!

name: Kelly Camacho
text: Buying our first home was such an exciting experience, but it was also pretty intimidating—especially since we were moving from the east coast and had never lived out West before. We first met Jacob at a coffee shop, where we got to know him and learn more about the area. From that first conversation, we felt like we were in good hands. He took the time to answer all of our questions, explain the area and the home-buying process, and made us feel completely comfortable. We always felt like he genuinely cared about us and what we were looking for. What stood out to us most was that Jacob was never pushy. Even when we looked at homes that we weren’t really interested in, he never tried to convince us to settle or rush into a decision. He listened to what we wanted, gave us honest advice, and genuinely cared about helping us find the right home. With his guidance, we eventually found what truly feels like our dream home. Because our home was a new build, Jacob continued to be there for us throughout the entire construction process. He came with us to several meetings with the builder, gave us thoughtful advice, and always made sure we were making decisions that were in our best interest. He was always punctual, responsive, professional, and just genuinely great to work with. He communicated with everyone involved and helped make the entire process feel as smooth and stress-free as possible. What we appreciate even more is that Jacob’s support didn’t end when we closed on our home. He still checks in to see how we’re doing and has connected us with trusted people for projects around the house, from mounting our TV to landscaping. That kind of care and follow-through really says a lot about who he is. We truly couldn’t be happier with our experience. Jacob made one of the biggest decisions of our lives feel exciting instead of overwhelming and we always felt like he had our best interests at heart. We would absolutely recommend him to anyone looking to buy or sell a home. If we ever need a realtor again, Jacob will be the first person we call. Thank you, Jacob, for helping us find not just a house, but a place we’re so proud to call home!

name: Conrad
text: Bought my first home through Jacob Stark at ExpRealty. The market was crazy and we saw more homes than we care to count. Jacob was dedicated to making all the showings happen and was super knowledgeable and prepared. He is professional with clients and other agents. I'd recommend him as an agent any day to anyone.

name: Charlie Selby
text: I’ve had the opportunity to work with Jacob on both the purchase of my first home and now on a new development project. Throughout each stage, he has demonstrated exceptional professionalism, market expertise, and a strong commitment to securing the best possible terms. His guidance has been invaluable, and his advocacy on my behalf has consistently exceeded expectations. I highly recommend Jacob to anyone seeking a knowledgeable, reliable, and results-driven real estate professional.

name: Fei Dai
text: When I was looking for a realtor online, I saw most of Jacob's clients left the views like they felt so lucky that they found Jacob. Actually that is exactly how we feel now. He is a very experienced and professional realtor that can give you a lot of suggestive advices, especially if you are a first home buyer. We also appreciated his negotiation power. If you're also looking at a popular area, Jacob could be your best partner to help you find your dream home. We really like his personality and the way he works with us. He also have rich resources to help if you want to do some remolding after purchase. We would highly recommend Jacob to our friends!

name: Erik Peddle
text: “We’ve had the pleasure of working with Jacob Stark both as a trusted realtor and as a valued client of Renovar Construction on several investment properties. Jacob brings integrity, market knowledge, and a true passion for helping people succeed. His professionalism and dedication make him a standout in the real estate world, and his collaborative approach made our project a great success. We’re grateful for his partnership and highly recommend Jacob to anyone seeking a realtor who operates with excellence and genuine care for his clients.”

name: Amber Weintraub
text: As first time home buyers, we are so lucky and grateful to have found Jacob! Genuine, professional, laid-back, and kind, he made what I thought would be a nerve-wracking experience easily accessible, talking through every question I asked until I felt confident. He also has plentiful connections with other professionals helping to create a smooth closing. With gentle guidance, attention to detail, and expert ability to fully understand our priorities, Jacob helped my husband and I compromise with each other where needed to find an incredible home we're both in love with! Our dog loves him, and we will absolutely be recommending Jacob to everyone!

name: Mitchell Lewis
text: Jacob is awesome! I am a first time home-buyer, and I really had no clue what I was doing. Jacob provided me with heaps of knowledge and assisted me from the very beginning, all the way to closing on my first home. He made what is typically a overwhelming process, much easier for me. I will certainly use Jacob again in the future whenever I plan on moving again!

name: Wade Adams
text: We can't describe how grateful and happy we our with Jacob and his expertise as a realtor! We recently moved to the Denver area and had no idea what to expect when looking at houses here! He was extremely knowledgeable, took the time to understand our needs, as well as, our wants and desires in our future home. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone who is in need of a realtor!

name: Mandie Hume
text: Jacob and his team made the whole process of selling your house easy and fast! His knowledge, expertise and great marketing resulted in strong offers and a sale in 3 days! Highly recommend Jacob to anyone contemplating selling their house.

name: Rob Ringstrand
text: Jacob was always accommodating to our requests or last minute changes. Helped us really figure out what we liked and wanted. Gave us great advice and suggestion that helped us to find the house we wanted.

name: Sara H. Miller
text: We cannot express enough how pleasant and easy it was to work with Jacob. He listened to all my very specific desires — from all the ‘little’ details of the interior & exterior, to the feel of the neighborhood. I felt like he knew exactly what I was hoping for in our next home. He was never pushy but always so patient and encouraging throughout the process. We loved working with Jacob & will absolutely be recommending him to others!

name: Dee
text: I had a complicated real estate situation to resolve and Jacob Stark took the job on willingly and worked diligently and professionally to its completion, taking on more tasks than necessary to help me through the ups and downs of the transaction. Because he was so willing and capable in handling so many of the additional tasks and because I was not local, he assumed much of the pressure and responsibility for getting this home sold, and quickly, at a price higher than expected. Additionally, Jacob provided options for presenting the best of the home, not pressuring but leaving the decision to us, and had a great network of other professionals- ie: legal, title, appraisers, stagers, repair services, etc. to ensure that each step of the sale went smoothly to its end. I would highly recommend Jacob Stark for any real estate transaction.

name: Kara Lindenmeyer
text: We had a great experience selling and buying with Jacob. He made the whole experience smooth and guided us every step of the way. He marketed our house so well that it sold quickly. You can tell he really cares about his clients as people and does his job with integrity.

name: Jo-Ann McIntosh
text: We used Jacob Stark to sell our home in Denver and he was outstanding! At our first meeting in our home, he spent lots of time answering our questions, providing data on the market in our area, and sharing details on his intensive marketing efforts for selling homes. Jacob made the process incredibly easy and took extra steps many other Realtors don’t, like having a pro come and give us staging tips, having professional photographs taken, as well as creating a video walk-through. When we saw our listing we were blown away! His hard work and knowledge of what it takes to sell a home really paid off - our listing looked amazing and knocked out the competition. Our house went under contract within four days of the first open house - at asking price. We accepted and Jacob and his team, walked us through every step of the closing process. It couldn't have been a more pleasant experience. I would recommend Jacob Stark to everyone I know. He’s a true professional and a genuinely nice guy. You’d be hard pressed to find a better Realtor.

name: Cynthia Leon -CO
text: Jacob was fantastic to work with. He is patient and knowledgeable, when I started to become overwhelmed by choices and options he helped me to focus on the things that were the most important. When we were ready to move forward with an offer, Jacob guided me in framing a winning offer so that I could secure the home that I was looking for. Jacob expertly negotiated inspection related items, helped me to fine a great lender and facilitated a smooth closing. I would highly recommend Jacob to anyone looking for a great realtor. Thanks so much Jacob - I would give you 10 stars if I could.

name: Daniel Kramer
text: Jacob was strategic, patient, and realistic. He didn't make any promises that were unrealistic and he was there for me every step of the way.

name: Nico Brouwer
text: My wife and I recently purchased our first home. This ended up being a very rushed process due to the hot market right now, but Jacob made everything a breeze! We didn’t know much at all about how to buy a home, but Jacob is extremely knowledgeable about both the housing market and about homes themselves, so he made this as stress free as possible. Him and his colleagues at 8z Real Estate are quick to respond and will go the extra mile to help you find the perfect home.

name: Dipesh Dipu
text: What would you want from your real estate agent? Advise that you can trust, knowledge that helps you make the right decisions, and skills that you can rely on to get the best value! Jacob is trustworthy, knowledgeable and reliable. He has a heart to serve his clients. We visited several houses and Jacob provided deep insights into the quality of construction, likely challenges in maintenance, potential improvements, and suitability for a peaceful dwelling. He was patient with our questions, understanding of our concerns, and mindful of our expectations. He helped us from the beginning of our home search till the very end when we closed, and from initiating dialogue for borrowing to securing a loan. He always had our interest at his focus. We enjoyed working with him and spending time talking about life, family, faith and real estate. He is now a great friend, who I'm very happy to recommend for your real estate needs.

name: Alexander Dowdell
text: We recently purchased a home with Jacob as our realtor. He was exceptionally professional, kind, and went above and beyond to make sure that we found the home that was right for us. He made the often tortuous home-buying process as painless as possible and helped us feel confident in each step of the process. 100% would recommend to anyone looking to buy or sell real estate!

name: Steve Lopez
text: Very professional,knowledgeable agent that I would refer and recommend to anyone buying are selling a home

name: Gary Halstead
text: Jacob was astonishing to work with. He took the time to listen to my concerns and answered all my questions. When things changes, on my part, he was flexible and tolerant. He seemed to me to be the kind of person who could work with anyone..I wasn't an easy client either but he made me feel like I was though. I'd recommend him to anyone asking! In my opinion, he's a rock star!

name: jordan quinn
text: Jacob was professional and timely in all our interactions. His guidance on the selling and listing strategy were excellent and lead to my home being off the market in just 3 days and for over the asking price! I thought sales like this were in the past and it was a tremendous blessing; all thanks to Jacob and his expertise and professional approach. Jacob gives each of his listings the VIP treatment regardless of list price and this made a difference in the sale of my home!

name: Cody Murray
text: As an Air Force veteran I have done my fair share of moving around and buying/selling houses. I have worked with several good realtors but Jacob is truly a step above. What sets Jacob apart is his meticulous attention to detail. Jacob helped us find the perfect home for our growing family and made the process smooth and easy. Now that we are settled in Colorado we will be using Jacob for all of our future real estate needs!

name: Lindsay Murray
text: Jacob has helped us with several home purchases/sales and we wouldn’t want to work with anyone else! He’s organized, knowledgeable, always advocates for you and helps keep you at ease through the whole process. We definitely recommend him to all of our family and friends!

name: Andy Hurt
text: Working with Jacob was extremely easy and efficient. Jacob takes the complexities out of the process and provide clear, crisp, and actionable items that actually make the journey fun.

name: Ranai Murray
text: Jacob recently helped my family with purchasing a home, and we were so thankful for his guidance and support during the process. Jacob was professional and thorough, and had a confidence that put at us ease. He made every step feel manageable and was a wealth of information along the way. It is evident that he is brilliant and hardworking, and people have a lot of trust in him. Thank you for an amazing home buying experience!

name: Barb Minden
text: Jacob is a true professional and worth the investment. I would recommend for him to handle the purchase of a new home and also in selling your home. You won't be disappointed.

name: Shelly McKeown
text: Jacob’s name was forwarded from Zillow for realtor assistance on a house I was interested. He was not the listing agent and met me that same day within 1 1/2 hrs to show me 2 houses. We found a third house the same weekend and put in an offer. Jacob saw me through a bidding escalation, inspection and closing within a 3 week period. Jacob gave me solid, thoughtful advice through every step. Highly recommend for a calm, smooth, thorough and thoughtful real estate transaction. Thanks Jacob :)

name: K&B Photos
text: Amazing realtor! Would recommend to anyone! He is helpful, kind and very knowledgeable! He helped us write the best offer that we could to get our home and he took so much stress of our plate!

name: Kyle Lindenmeyer
text: Jacob did amazing work for us! As long distance buyers, he was always willing to go see a house right away and do a remote showing. Also, very responsive to emails and texts! He knows the ins and outs of the market too. I highly recommend him if you’re looking to buy a house in Denver!

name: Sarah Piampiano
text: I cannot say enough about Jacob. He really makes you, the client, the number one priority, which is so refreshing compared to other agents I have worked with in the past. He is diligent, hard working and incredibly genuine and authentic. You feel at ease with him, but also 100% confident that he will make the buying/selling process as easy as possible. He brings great ideas to the table in terms of negotiation, yet will help you feel totally in control of the decision making process - I cannot recommend him enough. He will absolutely provide you the best service possible.

name: Kelly Shaffer
text: Jacob helped me and my husband buy our first home. He was prepared, communicative, professional, knowledgeable and helpful at every step along the way. Jacob was honest in what would go into a great offer and the pros and cons of each choice we made. He has connections in the area for whatever we needed, and clearly knows Colorado real estate. You’d be well served with Jacob as your realtor. Thank you!!!

name: ML DiRienzo
text: Jacob naturally eases the stress of real estate transactions. He's easy to talk to and made us feel comfortable right away, establishing a quick rapport. Jacob's also excellent in providing thorough market data and insights - more than his peers - positioning clients to make informed, confident decisions. I highly recommend Jacob to anyone seeking a strong realtor they can trust!

name: Mike Gruber
text: When it comes to choosing a real estate agent, I look for three main qualities: (1) integrity, (2) expertise, and (3) a fun personality. Jacob check all three boxes! I'd highly recommend him to everyone in search of a winning selling/buying experience!

name: Chad Murray
text: Jacob is a cut above. A former senior marketing exec who chose to start his own business and it shows. He advocated for me and offered helpful guidance through the entire process. I've done several transactions with him and refuse to be represented by anyone else. He runs his business as a consummate professional and on top of that, he's a great dude, really fun to work with.

name: Cynthia Barnes
text: You will never find a better realtor than Jacob Stark. From our first contact regarding homebuying all the way up to closing and even after that he is attentive, knowledgeable, patient, and kind. Give him a call or an email. I promise you will not be better taken care of by anyone else.

name: Jacques Perron
text: Jacob was extremely organized and professional. From our first meeting and until closing, he provided excellent advice and kept me informed timely of all the developments with the sale of my property. He was willing to go the extra mile to make sure I was well taken care of. It was a great experience. I would recommend Jacob anytime.

name: Haley Billimack
text: Jacob was an excellent real estate agent! He came to our first call well-prepared with a shared spreadsheet that outlined our process. That was super helpful to first-time home buyers. Throughout the process he was very responsive. He helped us get answers when we needed them, which was sometimes a quick turnaround. He also helped us find other resources we needed (inspector, lender) and provided some good questions for us to ask and things to watch out for. Jacob helped us find our dream home within about a month! We thought we had no chance of getting the home that we ended up with- it was highly sought after! Jacob helped us communicate with the sellers quickly so that we could understand their asks and ultimately get our house! We're grateful for Jacob's help and highly recommend his services as a real estate agent.

name: Cynthia Stark
text: We can't thank Jacob enough for all the work he did in selling our home and finding our dream home in this insane market! Jacob is extremely knowledgeable about this industry but more importantly his passion for real-estate and people shines through in every interaction. He is capable, kind, and he does everything with the utmost integrity. I wouldn't have wanted to trust anyone else with such a large task. Thank you Jacob for caring for our family and helping us day and night to sell our home and to find us a home perfect for our family!

name: Matthew Stark
text: Nothing but great things to say about our experience with Jacob! His communication, knowledge, expertise and dedication to our home sale and purchase were instrumental in helping us navigate the crazy Denver area market. Our initial seller and buying consults were very informative and we felt he had a great grasp of the areas we were selling and buying in. His positive attitude and outlook really kept us going as "the home" looked increasingly harder to find. We felt that his professional approach and communication with other agents gave us a competitive advantage in this tough market. During our home purchase he was very upfront about what it would take to draw up a winning offer and we were able to win the home and take it off the market without a round of weekend competition. I would recommend Jacob to anyone looking for an agent that is passionate about his job and willing to help his clients. Thank you Jacob!! We can't wait to use you again in the future!!

name: Michael Seeger
text: 2022 will go down as one of the craziest home-buying markets in Denver’s recent history - and boy we were we lucky to have Jacob on our side when buying our first home. Through the entire process, Jacob was the epitome of “professionalism”; constantly in contact with sellers’ agents to ensure that we had real-time information about certain listings so that we could put in our best possible offer. Even after losing out on multiple offers, Jacob remained his positive and jovial self, and continued to keep us at the top of his priorities. We’re so grateful to have been referred to Jacob by our lender and will definitely seek his services when purchasing our next property!

name: jonathan foster
text: Great experience working with Jacob. (If only there were six stars.)

name: Jonathan Dickerson
text: I've worked with a number of realtors over the years so the home-buying process is one with which I'm more familiar than many. But Jacob did such a great job from start to finish, helping us narrow down a search that was incredibly specific (trying to find a house for the aging in-laws that was close to their doctors, single floor, big enough for their stuff, easily manageable yard and of course, within budget) and Jacob not only found some options, but was able to walk through an incredibly difficult purchase (if anyone is interested in purchasing a home from Zillow, be advised, it will NOT go smoothly or according to plan). His professionalism shined throughout with quick communication and what appeared to be 24/7 availability. We wound up using his recommendations for inspections, home warranties (which I never buy, but he managed to get the Seller to include) and a number of other home professionals. I can't recommend Jacob highly enough: if you use him, your new/next home purchase process will be in great hands:

name: Stacy Dickerson
text: While buying a home can be stressful, working with Jacob was fun. He is patient, professional and wise. He made us feel cared for and important. Jacob did an excellent job making sure that we understood each part of the process, helped us to craft a strong offer in an insane purchasing climate, and continued to advocate for us as inevitable roadblocks popped up along the way. Thank you, Jacob!

name: Tina Garcia
text: Very willing to go out of the way to help find the perfect home for you we enjoyed working with him

name: Zachary
text: Jacob was extremely helpful during the home buying process. He came up with effective tools to compare houses, prioritize different aspects of potential homes, was super clear and concise through each step through closing. Highly recommend! Next time I need an agent in the Denver area I'll go right back to Jacob.

name: Cheryl Braunschweiger
text: Thank YOU Jacob!!! It's a pleasure to work with a true professional in Real Estate! Your dedication to getting the job done well did not go unnoticed!! It took great teamwork to get to the closing table and Im honored we did it together!! I look forward to working together again soon!

name: Feliz Murrieta
text: We are so grateful to have been able to work with such a great realtor. Really made our expierance enjoyable and so easy.
